the specification of the quality requirements of a system or software product, in order to obtain a high quality product.

ISO/IEC standard 25030 Software quality requirements and evaluation Quality requirements should include the following modifications: • a new requirements definition and specification process; • the addition of a new clause that would include the software quality model; • the addition and/or update of the software quality requirements; • the addition or update of the software product quality evaluation process.
the ISO/IEC standards 25010, 25020, 25030, and 25040 are not sufficient in their current form to support a software quality engineer in the specification of software quality requirements.

the ISO/IEC25030 standard needs to be modified in order to be used as a practical tool in specifying the system/software functional and quality requirements.
